description: Returns the full conditions of one offer of a Georgian bank. Use the bank and the id from offers_search_offers. Give the person the url of the offer with the conditions.

bank.description: The bank code of the offer.

language.description: The language of the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

name: offers_get_offer

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the terms, RFC 3339.

bank_categories.description: The names of the categories at the bank.

benefit.description: The text of the bank that states the benefit. Read the percent, the cap, and the conditions from it.

cards.description: The cards that the offer names. Absent: every card of the tiers.

code.description: The card code. cards of offers_search_offers takes it.

name.description: The name of the card at the bank.

categories.description: The offer categories, the same for every bank.

end_date.description: The last date of the offer, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the bank publishes none.

id.description: The offer id of the bank. offers_get_offer takes it.

kinds.description: The benefit kinds that the bank states in a field. other: the bank states none.

partner.description: The company that gives the benefit. Absent when the bank names none.

start_date.description: The first date of the offer, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the bank publishes none.

tiers.description: The customer tiers that can use the offer.

url.description: The page of the offer at the bank. Give it to the person with each offer that you name.

stale.description: True when the bank did not answer and the server returns terms it read before.

terms.description: The full conditions of the offer, as the bank writes them.

title: Terms of a card offer
